title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. In L2 regularization, this penalty is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients.

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: When lambda is set to a large value, the regularization term becomes significant. This forces the coefficients to be smaller, which can affect the slope of the decision boundary.

title: Impact on Training Error
text: Consider how reducing the magnitude of coefficients might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. What happens to the training error when the model is less flexible?
